case.question: Where can I open the sequence panel for L1HS in TE-KG?

agent_expectation.notes: Target only navigation; do not ask for biological synthesis.

run.question: Where can I open the sequence panel for L1HS in TE-KG?
run.answer:
The TE-KG entry for L1HS is [Sequence](http://127.0.0.1/TE-/search.php?q=L1HS&type=TE#search-sequence-panel).

If this is not the panel you wanted, use one of these choices:
- [Search summary](http://127.0.0.1/TE-/search.php?q=L1HS&type=TE#search-summary-panel) - Overview card for the selected TE.
- [Browse catalog](http://127.0.0.1/TE-/browse.php) - Catalog page for TE browsing and filtering.
- [TE-KG graph](http://127.0.0.1/TE-/preview.php?q=L1HS) - Interactive TE-KG graph preview.
